WishItem.title: WishItem
WishItem.description: An item in the couple's wishlist

id.description: The unique document ID for this wish list item

name.description: The mandatory name of the wishlist item

description.description: The optional description of the item

price.description: The optional price of the item

link.description: An optional link to the product

photo.description: An optional photo represented by an image URL or compressed Base64 data string

listId.description: The wishlist it belongs to: pipino (Dennis) or pipina (Alice)

listOwner.description: The email of the list owner

createdBy.description: The email of the user who created this item

isReserved.description: Whether the other person has reserved/purchased this gift

reservedBy.description: Unique email of the user who reserved this item, or null if unreserved

reservedAt.description: When the item was reserved, or null

wishitems/{itemId}.description: Collection of wish list items for Pipino and Pipina
